action: If you are a Caixa Vida e Previdência client, be wary of calls, emails or messages that cite your CPF or policy. Do not share codes or passwords, and use the company's official channel for questions.
exec: A large Brazilian insurer's registration base was copied; the company notified data regulator ANPD on 11 November.
impact: Registration data was copied out of the company's environment; affected holders whose phone or email was exposed are being notified.
plain: Intruders copied registration data from a Brazilian insurer tied to state bank Caixa; its base covers 7.6 million active clients. The company says no financial or password data appears affected.
summary: The insurer and pension company, part of Caixa Seguridade, said on November 12 it detected unauthorized access on November 6 and that registration data was copied. Per Estadão Conteúdo, the base covers all 7.6 million active clients plus ex-clients; names and CPFs for all records, other details for part. It says no financial or authentication data appears affected, and it notified ANPD on November 11.
title: Caixa Vida e Previdência breach exposes data of 7.6 million clients in Brazil

validation.note: Company market statement relayed by Folha PE (Estadão Conteúdo), O Liberal, Baguete and Diario de Pernambuco; the company's own filing not read.

review.note: 7.6M clients, data types, Nov 6 detection, Nov 12 disclosure, no financial data/passwords, ANPD against O Liberal, Baguete and Diario de Pernambuco
